Title: 6.1 Primary cells and secondary cells (1)
Description: Understand the differences, working principles, and chemical reactions of primary and secondary cells, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 6.1 Battery from inside (2)
Description: Explore the internal construction, components, and chemical layouts of standard batteries, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.
